programs.title: Mr White Mr Black
programs.desc: Gopi's dying father asks him to locate Kishen and hand-over a piece of land to him, and subsequently passes away. Gopi heads out to Goa and this is where he will be taken for a ride not only by Kishen, but also by Kishen's look-alike hoodlum brother, Hari.

programs.title: Phir Hera Pheri
programs.desc: The lives of three men changes overnight when they lose all the money they invested in a scam. Now, they must find another way to repay the dreaded loan sharks or face their death.

programs.title: Khoya Khoya Chand
programs.desc: A period drama about the lives, love, and struggles of actors in the Hindi film industry of the 1950s.
